adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, the `sendAddGuestsEmails` call is wrapped in `try/catch`, and the `catch` only does `console.log("Error sending AddGuestsEmails");` without logging the caught `err` or using any project logger. This makes email-delivery failures effectively invisible/debug-hostile while still returning success (`{ message: "Guests added" }`). It’s an observability/maintainability issue grounded in the diff, though not necessarily a functional correctness defect since the handler intentionally continues on email failure.
